description: This file contains internal utility functions related to session key handling within the ai.openclaw.app package. The functions perform normalization, validation, and resolution of session key strings used in the application's session management logic.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string, trimming whitespace and defaulting to 'main' if null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a trimmed session key string is the canonical 'global' or starts with 'agent:' indicating a valid main session key.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from a session key string if it starts with 'agent:'. Returns null otherwise.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for a node, incorporating device ID and optional agent ID, defaulting the agent ID to 'main' if not provided.
